from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pattern_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, background)]
    blank_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pattern_cells), max(r for r, c in pattern_cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pattern_cells), max(c for r, c in pattern_cells)
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in blank_cells), max(r for r, c in blank_cells)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in blank_cells), max(c for r, c in blank_cells)
    for r in range(zr0, zr1 + 1):
        for c in range(zc0, zc1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = grid[r0 + (r - zr0)][c1 - (c - zc0)]
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-7a51addb.py'
path.write_text(program)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_in=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
demo_pat=[[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]
for i,row in enumerate(demo_pat): demo_in[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(7,11): demo_in[r][4:8]=[0]*4
demo_out=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i,row in enumerate(demo_pat): demo_out[1+i][1:5]=row
for i,row in enumerate(demo_pat): demo_out[7+i][4:8]=row[::-1]
print('demo matches',mod.transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i,row in enumerate([[1,1,1,2],[1,1,2,1],[1,2,2,2]]): test[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(9,12): test[r][2:6]=[0]*4
result=mod.transform(test)
print(result)
print('blank replaced', all(v != 0 for row in result for v in row))
